early_same_source_alignment.direction: s01 world transformed to full world; compare same-source camera centres and orientations; no external truth

method.primary_fit: Kabsch rigid SE(3) and Umeyama similarity Sim(3), separately, using only 193 matching training camera centres
method.direction: s01 world -> full world; p_full approx s R p_s01 + t; orientation R_full^T R R_s01
method.scale_interpretation: Sim(3) fitted scale removes estimated metric-scale discrepancy; it must not be reported as rigid metric pose accuracy
method.limitations: Comparison of two estimated trajectories, not ATE against independent truth; similar early poses do not prove correct entire full trajectory

reader_check_summary.comparison: Historical GDataset.get_data, all RGB/sensor Z/K/c2w and PNG decoded with D=diag(1,-1,-1)

depth_support.reference_definition: Same-capture sensor colour-axis Z, inclusive 0.3-6 m; holes zero; no independent geometry truth
holes_causes: Multiple source samples collide at one output pixel
One output pixel per source sample leaves high-resolution grid gaps
depth_support.loss_mask_behavior: Selects each current valid pixel separately for x/y RGB-gradient weighting, then averages selected terms; no valid-depth-neighbor requirement and no division by full image area
depth_support.source_step_fraction_decomposition: Not available from committed aggregate arrays; must be counted from full native/rectified depth in next integrated run
depth_support.normal_diagnostic_interpretation: Empty four-neighbor reference support is not evidence that training depth loss is empty

scale_consistency.method: Train map observations only, track length >=3, reprojection <=2px, positive SfM Z. Round half-resolution corner-centred coordinates after subtracting 0.5. Take median of 5x5 Z_C with >=12 hits, no competing occluder, full local Z spread <=max(5cm,3%). Median of Z_C/Z_sfm; inverse track frequency then normalize each frame to equal total weight.
scale_consistency.fit_and_export_policy: 0.3–6 m fixed for primary fit and initialization before inspecting held-out depth. Overlapping/disjoint windows and thirds use training observations only.
scale_consistency.units: metric sensor consistency; no external geometric reference

values.interpretation: Pair statistics retain visibility and surface occlusion disagreements. Local smooth support does not eliminate cross-view occlusion. Quantile summaries across pairs are not pooled-pixel quantiles.

prior_cross_view_summary.caveat: 40 sampled directed pairs do not cover all poses; residual includes visibility/occlusion and sensor geometry, not pure pose error

geometry_units.scene_scale_interpretation: Axis-aligned scene bounding-box extent, not a 21x world scaling
geometry_units.pixel_centres: OpenCV K for undistortion/backprojection; +0.5 principal point once for COLMAP/Nerfstudio

initialization.excluded: competing occlusion hits and dilated near-side depth edges
initialization.distant_visibility_conclusion: Insufficient evidence to count how much visible far background has zero stable initialization; plausible coverage risk, not confirmed per-pixel diagnosis

next_complete_run_geometry_work: Verify source RGB/depth associations around 1288-1312 and 1510-1518; fix only independently confirmed pose anomalies with stable outside-window training map anchors.

Bounded local PnP and RGB-D relative constraints/local anchored BA on main train only; freeze stable map/global gauge/metric unit. Heldout remains query-only and is relocalized against the corrected fixed train map.
Preserve all 1846 primary timeline positions and original splits; publish any unresolved pose separately instead of dropping it or hiding the denominator.

If bounded correction remains unresolved, preserve actual estimates and explicit remaining uncertainty, continue the authorized complete run without inventing interpolated poses or entering an open-ended correction loop.

If any training pose changes, regenerate the complete train-derived initialization from source observations; a previously voxel-averaged mixed cloud cannot be repaired by moving only 11 stored points.
Measure all-depth processing support stages and native/640 normal-support once within the full run; do not confuse high-resolution sparse forward projection with absence of sensor measurements.
Retain 1280 RGB baseline while considering native-depth rays or provenance-preserving independent 640 depth rendering; never fill holes and evaluate synthetic fill as sensor observations.
Consider filtered, train-only, reprojectively supported SfM points for distant colour support; keep provenance and sensor-supported geometry masks distinct; do not blindly extend depth to 10 m.

Produce complete train-sensor TSDF after confirmed local pose correction as an input-chain comparison, alongside model surface exports; do not label it ground truth or assume it will outperform Poisson.
